name: note_accidental_velocity
description: Short chat (3 steps): set_note_accidental + set_note_velocity at low context. (set_note_head is covered in test_set_note_head.json — add_note+accidental+velocity+head exceeds the 3-step cap.)

steps.prompt: Add a quarter note F4 at measure 1 beat 1 staff 1.
Set the accidental of the note at measure 1 beat 1 staff 1 to sharp.
Set the velocity of the note at measure 1 beat 1 staff 1 to 80.
